[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant summarized SEC. 15, stating it contains miscellaneous provisions related to the implementation and enforcement of the Act.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that SEC. 15 exempts the Secretary from certain requirements of the Paperwork Reduction Act, allows expedited appointments, and excludes functions from certain provisions of title 5 of the U.S. Code.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that SEC. 15 provides for the protection of certain information in civil actions and clarifies that certain provisions of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act do not apply to civil actions under this Act.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that SEC. 15 establishes that there is no right of access to certain information in the possession of the federal government.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided an overall summary of the Foreign Investment Risk Review Modernization Act (FIRRMA), detailing its purpose, sections, and implications for national security.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that FIRRMA allows CFIUS to review and block foreign investments in U.S. companies that may pose national security risks.
